chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

You were created, O Ali, from a tree of which you were created; I am its root, and you are its trunk, and Al-Husayn and Al-Hasan are its branches, and those who love us are its leaves. So whoever clings to any part of it, Allah, the Mighty and Exalted, will admit him to Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of the tree metaphor in the hadith about Ali and the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* employs the botanical metaphor of the 'Tree of Prophethood' to illustrate the ontological hierarchy of the Ahl al-Bayt, positioning Ali as the central trunk supporting the branches of Hasan and Husayn. It emphasizes that spiritual attachment (*mawadda*) to this divine lineage is the guaranteed path to Paradise, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegesis of the Verse of Purification and the Verse of Love. The imagery underscores the organic unity of the Prophet, his progeny, and their followers as a single spiritual entity.
